Description: Compromised third-party dependency introduces malicious code or vulnerability into Aegis platform
Vulnerability: Dependencies not fully audited; reliance on external maintainers
Existing_Controls: Dependabot alerts; SBOM generation; container scanning
Additional_Controls: Pin dependency versions; review Dependabot alerts weekly; sign releases

Description: All knowledge/access/decisions concentrated in single person creates continuity risk
Existing_Controls: Documentation in git; password manager; policies documented
Additional_Controls: Runbooks; emergency contact procedures; key person insurance consideration

Description: Using personal accounts for corporate services limits access control and audit capabilities
Vulnerability: Personal accounts; no centralized identity management
Existing_Controls: MFA on all accounts; strong passwords
Additional_Controls: Implement Google Workspace; SSO for all services

Description: Source code hosted under personal GitHub account limits organizational controls
Vulnerability: Personal account; limited GitHub security features
Additional_Controls: Create GitHub organization; transfer repos; enable Advanced Security

Description: Future employees or contractors could misuse access or act maliciously
Vulnerability: Trust-based access model; limited monitoring for small team
Existing_Controls: Access reviews; least privilege; audit logging

Description: AWS GovCloud outage affects development and CI/CD
Notes: Dev-only impact; cost of multi-cloud exceeds benefit

Description: Secrets accidentally committed to source code repository
Additional_Controls: Pre-commit hooks; secret scanning; rotate exposed secrets

Description: Founder targeted by phishing to gain access to systems
Asset: All systems accessible via stolen credentials
Additional_Controls: Hardware security keys (FIDO2); email filtering; awareness training

Description: Failure to achieve or maintain SOC 2/ISO 27001 certification
Existing_Controls: Documented ISMS; evidence collection; internal audit program
Additional_Controls: Pre-audit readiness assessment; gap remediation plan
Notes: Internal audit required before audit ready

Description: Laptop theft or loss exposes source code and credentials
Additional_Controls: Remote wipe capability; biometric auth; encrypted backups

Description: Unpatched OS or software on developer workstation
Additional_Controls: Enable automatic updates; monthly patch verification

Description: Backup failure leads to data loss during incident recovery
Vulnerability: Git-based backup only; no tested restore procedure
Additional_Controls: Quarterly backup restoration tests; document recovery procedures

Description: Insufficient logging prevents incident investigation and forensics
Existing_Controls: CloudTrail; GitHub audit log; application logs
Additional_Controls: Log review procedures; centralized logging; retention policy

Description: Container image vulnerabilities in CI/CD pipeline
Additional_Controls: Trivy scanning in CI; block deployments with critical vulns; base image updates

Description: Evidence vault not operational prevents audit readiness
Additional_Controls: Complete vault setup; automate evidence collection; monthly verification

Description: API keys and tokens with excessive permissions
Asset: AWS IAM; GitHub tokens; service accounts
Threat: Credential compromise leading to privilege escalation
Additional_Controls: Least privilege review; scope tokens minimally; regular rotation

Description: Inadequate vendor security assessment for critical services
Additional_Controls: Annual vendor reviews; require SOC 2 reports; contractual security clauses
